title: Run out of Flint, then Johnny Neal's band in Milwaukee
summary: With Jonesy he stole wheels and fled Flint, then met Jabbo Smith while in Johnny Neal's band in Milwaukee.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. Me and Jonesy used to jack up cars and steal wheels. Well, they did that to us, you know. So we'd go into a good neighborhood and jack up a car, and take the wheels to fit our car, you know, so we were straight. I'm trying to think, Jonesy and myself... Well, somebody got mixed up with some people that belonged to the sheriff or something, and he gave us so many hours to get out of town. Then Jonesey was entangled with some little girl there, where we used to stay, and the father was looking for him with an axe. We hid until we got out of town. It was just me and him. And we went to Milwaukee then, from Flint. Then we met with Johnny Neal's band. Yeah, Johnny Neal. That's when I first met Jabbo. He was bad, man. Pshew! Cat sure can play. Yeah, I remember the sessions we used to have there. Then I had to leave there, because I was working... It

was really a joint where the cats used to come from Chicago and dry out, you know. They all liked me there, you know. I was working with Johnny Neal's Midnight Ramblers. So I used to say we should be on the radio. And one night I was singing...
